newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-DI FRANCESCO HOPES TO DELAY ITALY CALL-UP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DI FRANCESCO HOPES TO DELAY ITALY CALL-UP.

text.p: Midfielder Eusebio Di Francesco, who on Friday became the first Piacenza player to be called up by Italy, said he hoped he would be unavailable to join the national squad next week.
The 27-year-old, due to join Roma at the end of the season, said he was delighted with the call up for the four nation Tournoi de France starting on Tuesday.
But he said he had other pressing matters to attend to, such as helping Piacenza stave off relegation.
"I hope to have to put off the appointment with the national team. It will happen if we beat Perugia on Sunday."
Piacenza must beat Perugia, three points above them in serie A but also endangered, to keep their hopes alive.

If the northern club do win, they will be level on points with Perugia and involved in a further playoff next week at a neutral ground to settle the relegation battle, thereby making Di Francesco unavailable for Italy's first match.
